title: Genome-Wide Analysis of Triticum aestivum Root Meristem Growth Factor (RGF) Gene Family Highlights TaRGF5 as a Putative Component of Root-Associated Signaling.
authors: Khalil, Hala B; Alsahoud, Haidar A; Mostafa, Abdulrahman Darwish; Alhassan, Fatimah A; Al-Helal, Norah; Ikeno, Shinya
one_liner_zh: 该文对小麦RGF基因家族进行全基因组分析，并利用结构建模与分子对接预测TaRGF5与受体激酶TaRGI3的蛋白-蛋白互作，虽涉及肽-受体结合建模，但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Wheat (Triticum aestivum), a key global crop, faces rising drought stress that limits root growth and water uptake. Root meristem growth factors (RGFs) are small peptides that regulate root stem cell maintenance, meristem activity, and lateral root formation in model plants, yet the RGF gene family remains unexplored in wheat. Here, we performed a comprehensive genome-wide analysis of the TaRGF gene family, identifying 15 genes distributed across the A, B, and D subgenomes and classified into five homeologous groups (TaRGF1-TaRGF5), predominantly located on chromosomes 2 and 6. All TaRGFs contained a characteristic RGF motif, with dibasic cleavage sites and Asp-Tyr motifs indicating conserved maturation mechanisms. Based on the phylogenetic analysis, the TaRGF5 homeologs showed the highest similarity to Arabidopsis thaliana RGF5. Tested RNA-seq data revealed predominantly root-enriched expression for all TaRGF genes, with TaRGF5 exhibiting the most root-preferential and downregulation under drought stress. Quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) confirmed that drought stress suppressed the expression of TaRGF5A, TaRGF5B, and TaRGF5D in roots of wheat cultivar Sids-13 across all time points, unlike the higher accumulation seen in controls. Promoter analysis predicted a unique BES1 transcription factor binding site exclusively in TaRGF5B, linking brassinosteroid signaling to peptide-mediated root regulation. Structural modeling and molecular docking predicted an interaction between wheat TaRGF5 homeologs and root growth factor-insensitive receptor kinase (TaRGI3), characterized by conserved sulfotyrosine-mediated binding and favorable interaction energetics. Based on this characterization of the wheat RGF gene family, particularly the potential role of TaRGF5 in root development and drought-adaptation signaling, we propose targeting this gene for functional analysis to improve wheat resilience under water-limited conditions.
abstract_zh: 小麦（Triticum aestivum）作为全球关键作物，面临日益加剧的干旱胁迫，这限制了根系生长和水分吸收。根分生组织生长因子（RGFs）是在模式植物中调控根干细胞维持、分生组织活性和侧根形成的小肽，然而RGF基因家族在小麦中尚未被探索。在此，我们对TaRGF基因家族进行了全面的全基因组分析，鉴定出15个基因，分布于A、B和D亚基因组，并归类为五个同源组（TaRGF1-TaRGF5），主要位于2号和6号染色体上。所有TaRGF均含有一个特征性的RGF基序，具有二元切割位点和Asp-Tyr基序，表明其成熟机制是保守的。基于系统发育分析，TaRGF5同源物与拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）RGF5显示出最高的相似性。测试的RNA-seq数据揭示，所有TaRGF基因主要呈现根富集表达，其中TaRGF5表现出最显著的根偏好性，并在干旱胁迫下下调表达。定量实时PCR（qRT-PCR）证实，干旱胁迫在小麦品种Sids-13的根中抑制了TaRGF5A、TaRGF5B和TaRGF5D在所有时间点的表达，与对照组中观察到的较高积累相反。启动子分析预测了一个仅在TaRGF5B中存在的独特BES1转录因子结合位点，将油菜素内酯信号传导与肽介导的根调控联系起来。结构建模和分子对接预测了小麦TaRGF5同源物与根生长因子不敏感受体激酶（TaRGI3）之间的相互作用，其特征是保守的磺基酪氨酸介导的结合和有利的相互作用能量学。基于对小麦RGF基因家族的这一表征，特别是TaRGF5在根发育和干旱适应信号传导中的潜在作用，我们建议将该基因作为功能分析的目标，以提高小麦在水限制条件下的抗逆性。
